r.정치 구도: Civil war began in 2011, and the Assad regime fell in December 2024. A transitional government is preparing a new constitution and the rebuilding of the state.

t.why: The civil war drove more than 10 million people from their homes, long the world's largest refugee crisis. Since 2025 more people have been returning.
t.rel: Civil war began in 2011, and the Assad regime fell in December 2024. The new government is widening ties with the West and the Gulf states, while Israel occupies parts of the south and the Golan Heights.
t.korea: Parts of the country are under Korea's level-4 travel ban. Korea and Syria established diplomatic relations in 2025.
t.know: Damascus is counted among the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.
t.etext: Long civil war destroyed the economy. Since the change of government in 2024, sanctions relief and reconstruction investment have begun.
